left_out.rule: A model whose answers the parser reads in under 90 per cent of a build's items is reported apart as unable to do the task and left out of every pooled estimate (jmr-2026/PLAN.md, section 6; Study 2's open-models rule). Here the items are the choice items (shown, names-hidden, repeated and premium sets), whose answers are letters.

mbbe | blind_gap.note: the same answers give both, so their agreement is reported and not counted as convergence

convergence.note: corrected for the two measures' pooled split-half reliabilities over the same models' cells (plan, section 7 item 2); the interval's bounds are divided by the same factor
